The generated answer instead extrapolates from familiar Nb-Ta/Nb-Ti systems to predict Ti-driven enhancement through VEC, density-of-states, and electron-phonon-coupling changes. Its baseline lacks a definite composition and quantitative superconducting properties, and its proposed resistivity/magnetization measurements omit the decisive bulk heat-capacity comparison and microstructural identification of secondary phases. Although the series could test a plausible alternative research question, the mechanistic claims exceed the supplied evidence and do not answer the material-specific question posed.
